essence: The goddess is to be contemplated as adorned and radiant.
The goddess's feet are adorned with wave-bracelets and anklets.
The practitioner meditates on the goddess who is praised and smiling purely.
The sequence proceeds through rasa-water, wind, and fire.
The vidyā of royal Lakṣmī is declared to be sixteen-syllable.
